# Greater Good Science Center

> Research-backed science and practices for cultivating happiness, meaning, and social connection in daily life.

The Greater Good Science Center at UC Berkeley translates scientific research on well-being, mindfulness, relationships, and social connection into practical resources for individuals, educators, parents, and workplace leaders. The center offers evidence-based articles, interactive self-assessment tools, videos, and guidance grounded in psychological research.

## Key Topics

- well-being
- mindfulness
- gratitude
- emotional intelligence
- social connection
- relationships
- family relationships
- workplace wellbeing
- diversity and inclusion
- mental health
- self-assessment
- psychological research
- parenting
- education

## Core Topic Hubs

- [Mind & Body](https://greatergood.berkeley.edu/mind_body): Topic hub covering meditation, happiness, and mindfulness practices
- [Relationships](https://greatergood.berkeley.edu/relationships): Topic hub covering trust, diversity, and family communication
- [Parenting & Family](https://greatergood.berkeley.edu/parenting_family): Research-backed parenting advice and family relationship resources
- [Workplace](https://greatergood.berkeley.edu/workplace): Workplace wellbeing hub covering mindfulness, diversity, and organizational culture
- [Education](https://greatergood.berkeley.edu/education): Teacher resources and educator guides for social-emotional learning

## Self-Assessment Quizzes

- [Purpose in Life Quiz](https://greatergood.berkeley.edu/quizzes/take_quiz/purpose_in_life): Interactive assessment measuring life purpose using the Claremont Purpose Scale
- [Gratitude Quiz](https://greatergood.berkeley.edu/quizzes/take_quiz/gratitude): Self-assessment measuring gratitude using psychological scales
- [Altruism Quiz](https://greatergood.berkeley.edu/quizzes/take_quiz/altruism): Personality assessment of altruism and prosocial helping behaviors
- [Connection to Humanity Quiz](https://greatergood.berkeley.edu/quizzes/take_quiz/connection_to_humanity): Quiz measuring empathy and global identification
- [Social Capital Quiz](https://greatergood.berkeley.edu/quizzes/take_quiz/social_capital): Assessment tool measuring strength of social connections online and offline
- [Happiness at Work Quiz](https://greatergood.berkeley.edu/quizzes/take_quiz/happiness_at_work): Self-assessment measuring workplace happiness and satisfaction
- [All Quizzes](https://greatergood.berkeley.edu/quizzes): Collection of self-assessment quizzes on well-being and happiness

## Video Resources

- [Bridging Differences for Teens and Parents](https://greatergood.berkeley.edu/video/series/bridging_differences_for_teens_and_parents): Video series on teen-parent communication and emotional intelligence
- [Video Library](https://greatergood.berkeley.edu/video): Comprehensive video library on parenting, well-being, mindfulness, and happiness
